verification.note: addons/intelligence/frontend/ClipFramesSection.tsx:211 uses `mouse:max-h-[17.5rem] mouse:overflow-y-auto`. The frontend uses Tailwind v4 with no tailwind.config, and no `@custom-variant`/`addVariant` or `mouse` variant is defined in any frontend CSS or JS (grep finds none). So the strip has no height bound and is not a scroll container. The IntersectionObserver at :133-148 uses root=stripRef, and the sentinel at :240-246 always intersects it, so showCount grows until every row is rendered. decisions.md R-5 saw this in the running app: 112 buttons for the .loft and 75 for the native video right after expand, and no 17.5rem rule in the built stylesheet. ClipFramesSection.test.tsx:209-212 only regex-matches class names. The submodule reflog shows how the change got in: the scene-tiles branch was cut from f803f99, which is addon main fast-forwarded past 1f38a24, so the class reaches this diff range through the bump. It was not written in this branch's own commits. The same unbounded layout also affects VisualIndexSection.tsx:276.

addons/intelligence/frontend/VisualIndexSection.tsx:276 has `flex flex-wrap gap-3 p-1 mouse:max-h-[30.75rem] mouse:overflow-y-auto pointer-coarse:...`, and VisualIndexSection.test.tsx:311-314 asserts those classes. Neither file is in the touch-point list. In the submodule reflog (logs/HEAD lines 16-18), the scene-tiles branch starts from f803f99, the fast-forward of addon main past 1f38a24, so this upstream work is inside the gitlink diff range.

addons/intelligence/frontend/AdminFeaturesSettingsSection.tsx:160 (headClass) and :203 (first <td>) carry `break-anywhere`, and AdminFeaturesSettingsSection.test.tsx:133-135 asserts it. The file is not in the touch points. It enters the range the same way as F2: the branch is based on the fast-forwarded addon main (f803f99) and the base gitlink is 1f38a24.

specification_compliance: Touch-point list is narrower than the actual diff range: because the core base gitlink is 1f38a24 and the addon branch sits on fast-forwarded addon main plus the youtube-frames commits, the bump carries SPEC-ADDON-076/077/078, an mcp-server change, a Dockerfile change and unrelated frontend layout changes.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The CLIP frames strip and VisualIndexSection strip are unbounded on mouse devices because the `mouse:` variant is undefined, so 20-at-a-time paging (I6) never happens in practice.
regression_risks: Native video panels also render all frames at once after expand (75 rows observed in R-5), issuing many /frame requests (lazy-loaded) instead of paging.
The protected-path classifier does not see Dockerfile edits inside the submodule, so CRITICAL zone gating is bypassed for this bump.
test_coverage: ClipFramesSection.test.tsx:209-212 and VisualIndexSection.test.tsx:311-314 only regex-match class names and cannot detect that the `mouse:` variant generates no CSS.
